_comment: Per-locale reader register, chosen by page path. A prompt head containing {{REGISTER}} gets the matching instruction; heads without it are unaffected. Prefixes are matched against the path under site/. Read by prompt_head.py (bash and Python callers) and by sync.mjs (block-level updates).

text.kamu: Address the reader informally as "kamu" (friendly tone for tutorials and guides). Never use "Anda".
text.anda: Address the reader formally as "Anda" (technical and reference pages). Never use "kamu".
